definitions.explanation: Making paper by hand, dipping a frame into a vat of plant-fibre pulp, as opposed to machine-made paper. Usually used before {和紙|わし} or {紙|かみ} to describe paper made this way.

examples.english: In this village they still make paper by hand.

examples.japanese: {手漉|てす}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{厚|あつ}さや⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Each sheet of handmade paper differs slightly in thickness and feel.

notes:

- {手漉|てす}き⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧: handmade washi
- {手漉|てす}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧: paper made by hand
- {手漉|てす}き⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: a papermaking workshop for visitors
